note: Starting stats for Advanced mode. Health and whether a character fires tears come from the game's own players.xml; the combat multipliers are compiled into the game rather than shipped as data, so they are transcribed from the wiki's attribute table — see tools/scrape-characters.mjs, which spells out how that table's columns line up. A character whose attack is not tears carries a caveat rather than a confident DPS number that would be wrong.
source: players.xml via Derugon/TBoIR-resources (health, canShoot) + wiki attribute table (combat multipliers)

characters.name: Isaac
characters.note: The baseline. 3.5 damage, 10 frames between tears, 2.73 tears a second.

characters.name: Magdalene
characters.note: The most health in the game and the slowest legs to carry it.

characters.name: Cain
characters.note: Fast, hits harder, sees less of the room — the shortest range of the starting three.

characters.name: Judas
characters.note: A third more damage for a single heart container.

characters.name: Dark Judas
characters.note: Double damage, four black hearts, and nothing else to lose.
Six soul hearts and no containers, so nothing heals you.

characters.name: Eve
characters.note: Starts at three quarters damage. Whore of Babylon lifts her back at low health, which this does not simulate.

characters.name: Samson
characters.note: Slightly slower tears that travel faster, and all three hearts kept.

characters.name: Azazel
characters.note: Half again the damage, six black hearts, and a fraction of the fire rate.
characters.caveat: Brimstone is a continuous beam rather than tears, so the stats are real but the DPS built from them is an approximation.

characters.name: Lazarus
characters.note: Ordinary until he dies, at which point he gets stronger.

characters.name: Lazarus Risen
characters.note: The second life: more damage and quicker feet than the man who died.

characters.name: Eden
characters.note: Rolled at random, every run.
characters.caveat: Every stat is randomised at the start of a run. These are the midpoints, not what you would actually get.

characters.name: The Lost
characters.note: One hit. Everything else about the build is academic.
characters.caveat: Dies to a single hit. The health here is accurate and still understates how sharp that is.

characters.name: Lilith
characters.note: Blindfolded. Her familiar is the whole offence.
characters.caveat: Fires no tears at all — Incubus does the shooting. The DPS here describes an attack she does not have.

characters.name: Keeper
characters.note: Coin hearts, a heavy tear penalty and the worst luck in the game.
characters.caveat: Health is coin hearts, which behave differently from the containers this model counts.

characters.name: Apollyon
characters.note: Isaac with a Void. The stats are plain; the item is not.

characters.name: The Forgotten
characters.note: Half again the damage, halved fire rate, and a club instead of tears.
characters.caveat: Swings a bone club. His tear stats exist but most of his damage is melee, which this does not model.

characters.name: The Soul
characters.note: The other half of the Forgotten, quick and fragile.
characters.caveat: Fights with a chain rather than tears.

characters.name: Bethany
characters.note: Three containers plus soul charges, at ordinary stats.

characters.name: Jacob
characters.note: Lower base damage than anyone, but the fastest tears and good luck.

characters.name: Esau
characters.note: The highest base damage in the game, on the longest range, tied to a brother who is not.
